note: Source of truth for the arcade. Add a live title: folder /games/<slug>/ plus one object here. status: live | coming.

games.title: Lattice Marines
games.blurb: Place three HQs, branch build range, probe Battleship fog, and fight a never-ending campaign vs local AI or hot-seat. Δ9 commanders from this site.

games.title: Lattice Swarm
games.blurb: Hex command — Week 1: slower opening, undo, keys 1–6. Build, defend, keep entropy from unraveling the lattice.

games.title: Stock Market Masters
games.blurb: Never-ending play-money quotation board. Two dice per turn. Cash out when you want — highest net worth ranks on the TOP Cashout hall.

games.title: Eternal Lattice
games.blurb: Week 1: undo (Z), keys 1–8, How to play. Champion card battles — campaign, Deckwright, Lattice Forge.

games.title: Lattice Golf
games.blurb: 2.5D course: plant a marker, read the wind pip, watch the ball fly. Pine Haven, Coral Lattice, Singularity Nine, endless, campaign vs AI. Live hall. Live lobby 1–4.

games.title: Haven Rally
games.blurb: Time-trial lattice racer plus a full drag facility: 1/8 mile, 1000 ft, and 1/4 mile vs AI, Christmas tree, F to restage. Apex Mk I, ghost, live hall.
games.coverAlt: Haven Rally Apex Mk I studio shot

games.title: Lattice Grand Prix
games.blurb: Unity arcade racer. A 20-event career across 5 ranks, rival AI on their own lines, nitrous, and a pit lane. Free in the browser. No account.
games.coverAlt: Orange open-wheel car on a dark twilight circuit

games.title: LYGO Dungeon Adventures
games.blurb: Still-frame dungeon. Four locked characters, open d20 fights, and the same wolf picture stacked harder by area. Gear on top of level. Free in the browser. No account.
games.coverAlt: A wolf on a dusk forest path

games.title: Lattice Crypt
games.blurb: Jobs of the Accord. 24-floor campaign, endless, Survival with a level-first horde ramp. Fog-band spawns, live Hugging Face hall.

games.title: Fish Tank
games.blurb: Eighteen species, including rare marine fish and one octopus. Six ages. Adult in a day, a week unless you use pellets. Local save. Cemetery hall ranks the longest lives.
games.coverAlt: Daylight aquarium with plants, stones, and driftwood

games.title: Lattice Corridor
games.blurb: Freedoom Phase 1, Phase 2, and FreeDM, plus Lotan's Tomb, on a real PrBoom engine. Fast, respawn, and coop rules. Load a WAD you own, or the 1993 shareware episode. Unofficial.
games.coverAlt: A dark stone corridor with amber lattice light in the floor

games.title: Vale Tactics
games.blurb: The Moonlit Slumber through Eternal Haven Dawns. Serenya wakes in the loft. Choose Cantor, Warden, or Kindler. Painted pages carry the road, and the grid opens when someone has to be faced. The story stays in this browser.
games.coverAlt: Serenya and a small bronze-green dragon on a moonlit harbor balcony

games.title: LYGO 98
games.blurb: An unofficial LYGO desk. Teal field, gray windows, mail, pictures, and a saver you can boot from. Rook's papers hide a second trail into the public lattice. Not affiliated with Microsoft.
games.coverAlt: LYGO 98 on a teal field, with a gray window and a LYGO button

games.title: LYGO Arena
games.blurb: Two AI teams, one stone ring. Pick 1v1 to 5v5 from 33 real kits — champions, crypt creatures and the pack — then watch every move, card and cooldown play out on its own. Challengers are drawn blind.
games.coverAlt: Four fighters at a cyan lattice gate under the LYGO Arena wordmark

games.title: Lattice Chess 3D
games.blurb: Sculpted stone chess in a gothic cathedral. Cinematic captures, stone shatter physics, and a local chess AI. Free in the browser.
games.coverAlt: Lattice Chess 3D stone pieces on a cathedral chessboard

games.title: Lattice Arcade
games.blurb: Turn two photos into pixel fighters, then run a neon retro maze. Local sprite generation, local AI, no account.
games.coverAlt: Lattice Arcade neon maze with two pixel fighters

games.title: Lattice City
games.blurb: Build a living 16x16 pixel city, then expand into a 48x48 LYGO Endless district. 256 tiles, snapshot export, local legend score.
games.coverAlt: Lattice City isometric pixel city with roads and a canal

games.title: Lattice Tennis
games.blurb: 3D arcade tennis with racket kinematics, expressive pilots, keyboard/mouse and controller play, and optional webcam motion. No camera required.
games.coverAlt: Lattice Tennis court with two pilots at the net

games.title: More games coming
games.blurb: New HTML5 titles drop into /games/<slug>/ and this catalog. The arcade reads one JSON file — no store, no account.

games.title: Forge Smoke
games.blurb: Rain, wreckage and a shrinking perimeter. WASD move, auto-fire, R reload, Q swap, M2 aim, 1/2/3 cards. The armory is winning.
games.coverAlt: Forge Smoke title card over a rain-soaked arena
